$comment: Intentional deviations from the official suite. Keys are case ids (<group>/<file>[#index]). Each entry needs a "reason" and may set "skip": true, "alternateResult" or "alternateCode". Keys starting with '$' are ignored.

function-string/case019.reason: `1/0` overflows to infinity, which JSON cannot hold: jlens raises D1001 at the division, where jsonata-js passes Infinity on and $string raises D3001 (see "A number that overflows to infinity" in docs/src/language/compatibility.md).

function-encodeUrl/case002.reason: The case file contains a lone UTF-16 surrogate (U+D800). Rust strings are UTF-8 and cannot represent it, so neither the test data nor a jlens input can carry this value.
